pairs.registryProposal: Prior verdict (rev 27, not-applicable, 'assembles text only') was wrong: cli_args.rs assembles the spawn (roster, budget, turns, effort, env). The defect found - a continuation re-assembles the runtime from a narrower input than the fresh run and silently widens the tool roster - has no technique that names it directly; assembly-identity catches only the record half. Candidate rule: a resume/continuation is a re-assembly and must re-apply every capability restriction the fresh assembly applied, or refuse.
